agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse: TokenList.flatten() in sqlparse/sql.py had its branches inverted (yielding whole group tokens with stale cached .value instead of recursing into them, and calling .flatten() on leaf tokens instead of yielding them directly). This broke __str__ for any TokenList whose nested tokens were mutated by a filter after grouping, including StripCommentsFilter removing comments nested inside Identifier groups. Restored correct behavior: recurse into is_group tokens via 'yield from token.flatten()', yield leaf tokens directly via 'yield token'. Verified strip_comments now correctly removes single-line and multiline comments including in nested subqueries, and reindent/keyword-case/multi-statement formatting continue to work correctly.
